description.fun: Tapu Fini, guardian of Poni Island, controls water and draws energy from ocean currents. It hides in a mysterious fog that sends foes into a self-destructive trance, and it uses the same fog to test anyone who seeks its special water, said to cleanse anything it touches. So many people with bad intentions have tried that it doesn't care much for humans, though it will help those who prove worthy.
description.guide: Tapu Fini is a Water- and Fairy-type Legendary Pokémon, the guardian deity of Poni Island in Alola. It manipulates water and conjures a dense fog. Its closed shell resembles a swordfish, and it may draw on Kanaloa, the Hawaiian god of the ocean.
description.tagline: Poni's misty sea guardian that tests all who seek its water
